title: WD22-MARGIN160: a twenty-two-input recursive window dissection extension at smaller classical space

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ,n=ceil(log2 N),the single WD22-MARGIN160 configuration completely defined in proof.md(finite exhaustive branch below2^32768;otherwise r=ceil(sqrt n),U=min{u>=0:u^100>=n^49},actualw=floor(3r/20)-16U,y7=ceil(3w/4),y11=ceil(35w/34),y16=ceil(7w/8),y22=ceil(1533r/10000),binary/seven/eleven/sixteen/twenty-two-input measured-window recursive whole-fiber listing,finiteStepCap2^(2kappa+14),K=8192(3r+ceilLog2n+30),actualsource/demand caps and physical odd/twoadic decoding) recovers the ENTIRE secret with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8 from independent ideal copies. On EVERY branch,including wrong estimates,discarded copies,list/merge failures and cap aborts,charged sequential work is O(2^[(1112693/471750)sqrt(n)-160n^(49/100)]),with an absolute constant.
